mods.name: Cobbliki REI
mods.description: REI integration for Cobblemon: look up defeat drops, pasture loot, TM/move compatibility (per form), evolutions, evolution items, mega evolution, fossil resurrection, and CobbleDollars shop prices — all read live from your installed content.

releases.notes:
Big feature update since 0.7.x.

**New**
- Pokédex (R on a Pokémon): 3D model, base stats, types with hover matchups, abilities + effect text, riding stats, and "where to find" spawns (biomes, structures, rarity, level, conditions). Per-form (Alolan/Galarian/Mega/etc.), built on demand.
- Trainer Drops: which trainer drops a badge/reward, shown as the 3D trainer NPC (needs Radical Cobblemon Trainers).
- Full CobbleDollars Buy/Sell including merchant shops (gems, stones, evo items, vitamins…) with real prices and item components.

**Improved**
- Evolutions now cover held-item trades (Dubious Disk, Metal Coat…) and datapack species_additions.
- Mega Evolution covers X/Y and special combinations; R resolves to the mega form.
- Full form names everywhere; move type/category follow game language.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Cobblemon 1.7.x, REI 16.x.
